portal_hypertension.abstract: Fontan patients are considered high risk for heart transplantation (HT) owing to their complex anatomy, multiple prior chest entries, and universal Fontan-associated liver disease (FALD). The impact of FALD and other preoperative factors remains, however, uncertain. We sought to identify factors associated with 90-day mortality after isolated HT in adults with Fontan circulation, with particular focus on the relationship between liver-related parameters and post-transplant outcomes. A retrospective cohort study of all adult Fontan patients undergoing isolated HT was conducted. portal_hypertension.abstract: Portomesenteric venous thrombosis (PMVT) after colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery is most often reported in symptomatic patients, leaving its frequency and natural history across the asymptomatic spectrum poorly defined. When encountered incidentally, it frequently prompts anticoagulation, hypercoagulability evaluation, or delays in oncologic treatment, despite limited evidence that intervention alters its course. Using a cohort with routine postoperative imaging, we characterized the incidence, anatomic distribution, risk factors, and clinical course of asymptomatic PMVT.
